data.description:
Implement `watchDbChanges` in `packages/herdr/src/db-change.ts` (parent WL-0MV02VA29009WBEN).

## Goal
A cheap, cross-process-safe watch over the worklog change signal so the pane can react to an agent write promptly.

## Scope
- `watchDbChanges(cacheDir, worklogDir, opts)`: watches the state-counter file (`state/<hash>.json`) and/or `worklog.db`/`-wal`, debounces/coalesces bursts, and emits a change callback.
- Fail open: any watch/read error is reported as unavailable so the caller falls back to polling. Never throws into the TUI loop.
- `dispose()`/`close()` for teardown on pane exit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `watchDbChanges` watches the cross-process DB-change signal (state counter and/or SQLite `worklog.db`/`-wal`), debounces events, and emits at most one change callback per burst.
- The watch fails open: any read or `fs.watch` error is reported as unavailable and the caller falls back to the 30 s auto-refresh tick.
- Watch teardown (`dispose`) removes all `fs.watch` handles and timers.
- Unit tests cover the watch trigger, debounce/coalescing, and fail-open fallback, with injected `fs.watch`/clock.

## Implementation notes
- Prefer `node:fs` `watch` (no new runtime dependencies). Handle the state-counter file being absent at start-up (watch the `state/` directory or fall back to polling).
- Inject `fs.watch`/timers for deterministic tests (mirror the `db-change.test.ts` mocking style).

## Dependencies
- F1 verification harness (shared contract tests).
data.title: Event-driven DB-change watch primitive

## Post-change measurement (session herdr-1791814520-3149170-2335)

Measured at worktree HEAD `467b4f4e` after all six dedup children landed. Full details recorded in `docs/dev/test-suite-baseline.md` (new 'Post-change measurement' section).

### Raw post-change results
- **Test files:** packages 128, `tests/` 243, `test/` 0 — total 371 (baseline 358).
- **Full suite:** 370 passed / 1 skipped (371 files); 7952 passed / 5 skipped (7957 tests); vitest 643.68s; wall clock 10:45.65.
- **Canonical suite:** `tests/cli` 98 files / 863 tests (859 passed, 4 skipped), 297.81s; `tests/unit` 31 files / 519 passed, 7.20s; total 129 files / 1382 tests, runner elapsed 355.4s.
- Full suite is **green**.

### Isolated epic contribution
- Legacy `test/`: 9 → 0 (6 relocated to `tests/`, 3 deleted after coverage migrated).
- `tests/validator.test.ts` (verbatim subset) deleted.
- 2 new `tests/` files added to preserve migrated coverage.
- **Net -8 test files; net -7 test cases, all redundant** (1 verbatim subset, 3 throttler already covered, 3 duplicate `iconsEnabled`). Meaningful coverage unchanged.

### Confounders (documented in the doc)
- Host load average ~38/16 cores during the post-change run (several unrelated drives): the 243s→644s runtime increase is **not** attributable to this epic.
- Unrelated concurrent commits added files (packages +13, tests/cli splits), inflating raw counts.

### AC verification
- Before/after runtime + test counts measured and reported: ✅ (this comment + doc).
- Full suite passes with no meaningful coverage reduction; removals accounted for per child: ✅.
- Delta reported on the parent: ✅ (parent comment).
